annotations.title: Add or remove items in your pack

description: Requires a JWT (never an rk_ key). Change YOUR pack's items: add / remove are lists of {kind: rig|skill|harness|agent, ref} — ref = the registry listing id (rig/skill/harness) or your Forge agent id. Only items you own may be added; one foreign item refuses the whole call (403 not_yours) and nothing is written. At most 100 items per pack. Returns the pack.
name: pack_items_set
title: Add or remove items in your pack
